paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.04% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+2.52%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.36%). Brent crude changed +2.86% to 105.24. Gold changed -1.57% to 4,136.3999. Bitcoin changed -2.48% to 82,659.5703. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of -0.30%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-7.59%) and Deutsche Bank (-6.52%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Markets). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Central banks and macro: Iran war blows near-£12bn hole in Britain’s public finances (FT World). FT estimates show inflation and soaring borrowing costs have slashed chancellor John Healey’s headroom in half Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors target Middle East despite war disruption (FT Markets). Western groups seek new investment opportunities despite chaos and heightened risks caused by conflict with Iran
